name: lightcone-research
description: Agent skills for the Lightcone Research stack — the ASTRA spec and lightcone-cli project workflows.
generated: Run `npm run build` to regenerate. Do not edit by hand.

skills.name: astra
skills.description: Comprehensive reference for the `astra.yaml` specification — top-level structure, sub-analyses, inputs/outputs, decisions and options, prior insights and findings, evidence and quote verification, narrative anchors, and composition mechanics. Invoke whenever reading, writing, validating, or debugging an `astra.yaml` spec; whenever working with decisions, options, prior_insights, findings, or evidence; or whenever the user asks about ASTRA schema, spec syntax, or sub-analysis composition.

skills.name: feedback
skills.description: File a bug report from the current session. Use when something breaks: /feedback <description of what went wrong>

skills.name: start
skills.description: Entry point for working with a Lightcone / ASTRA analysis. Inspects the project state first, then routes: for an empty or freshly-scaffolded directory it scopes a new analysis from your research question; for an existing project it summarizes the analysis state (validation, materialization, decisions, findings, universes) and helps you choose the next step — run or verify outputs, refine decisions, write narrative, or publish. Use whenever you start, open, set up, continue, or resume work on a lightcone-cli / ASTRA project, or ask "what next" — e.g. "start a lightcone analysis", "set up my project", "continue the analysis", "what should I do next", or any session opened in a directory that has (or will have) an `astra.yaml`.

plugins.name: lightcone
plugins.description: Work with a Lightcone / ASTRA analysis using the lightcone-cli (lc) toolchain. The `start` skill inspects project state and routes — scoping a new analysis from a research question, or surfacing the next step (run/verify outputs, refine decisions, write narrative, publish) on an existing one — and `feedback` files bug reports. Ships SessionStart/PostToolUse hooks that activate the project venv and validate astra.yaml on save, plus the lc-extractor subagent for literature extraction. Use for any interactive work inside an lc / ASTRA project. The `start` skill bundles the full lc CLI reference (references/cli.md).
